# valicon v1.9.2 - Table of Contents

> A comprehensive set of data structure validation and related helper functions, designed to work without external dependencies.

## Modules

- [Valicon](https://valicon.hexdocs.pm/Valicon.md):   The collection of ectoless validation and helper functions for validation
  of pure data structures.

- [Valicon.Conversions](https://valicon.hexdocs.pm/Valicon.Conversions.md):   Data transformation functions. Pretty generic but used mostly before calling the validations.

- [Valicon.Validations](https://valicon.hexdocs.pm/Valicon.Validations.md):   The different validations that can be applied to the attributes.
